vocabularies.name: EventType
vocabularies.description: Type discriminator of a thread event delivered on orchestration.subscribeThread.

vocabularies.name: CommandType
vocabularies.description: Type discriminator of a client command sent to orchestration.dispatchCommand.

vocabularies.name: StreamItemKind
vocabularies.description: Payload discriminator of a subscription snapshot or update.

vocabularies.name: ActorKind
vocabularies.description: Origin of a thread event.

vocabularies.name: TimelineEntryKind
vocabularies.description: Which payload of a timeline entry's tagged union is populated.

vocabularies.name: MessageRole
vocabularies.description: Author of a timeline message.

vocabularies.name: MessageDelivery
vocabularies.description: A user message on its way to the provider; absent once delivered.

vocabularies.name: TurnState
vocabularies.description: Lifecycle state of a thread's latest turn.

vocabularies.name: SessionStatus
vocabularies.description: Status of a thread's provider session binding.

vocabularies.name: ApprovalStatus
vocabularies.description: Whether an approval request is still awaiting a decision.

vocabularies.name: ApprovalDecision
vocabularies.description: Client decision on an approval request.

vocabularies.name: RequestType
vocabularies.description: What an approval request is asking permission for.

vocabularies.name: AuthKind
vocabularies.description: How a sign-in method or challenge proceeds.

vocabularies.name: AttachmentKind
vocabularies.description: What a message or tool attachment carries.

vocabularies.name: StopReason
vocabularies.description: Why a completed turn ended early; absent when it finished normally.

vocabularies.name: OutputFormat
vocabularies.description: How to render tool output; absent means plain text.

vocabularies.name: QuestionKind
vocabularies.description: Input a user-input question takes.

vocabularies.name: ItemKind
vocabularies.description: Kind of a non-message timeline item.

vocabularies.name: ItemStatus
vocabularies.description: Lifecycle status of a timeline item.

vocabularies.name: GoalStatus
vocabularies.description: Status of the goal a provider pursues over its turns.

vocabularies.name: ToolAction
vocabularies.description: Action a provider explicitly stated for a tool call; absent when it stated none.

vocabularies.name: FileChangeKind
vocabularies.description: Kind of a normalized file mutation produced by a tool.

vocabularies.name: ConfigOptionType
vocabularies.description: Control a session config option renders as.

vocabularies.name: ConfigOptionCategory
vocabularies.description: Advisory grouping hint for a session config option; unknown values must be tolerated.

vocabularies.name: PlanEntryStatus
vocabularies.description: Status of an execution-plan checklist entry.

vocabularies.name: PlanEntryPriority
vocabularies.description: Priority of an execution-plan checklist entry.

vocabularies.name: InstanceStatus
vocabularies.description: Lifecycle of a provider instance: configured but never started this run, alive, or exited.

vocabularies.name: AuthStatus
vocabularies.description: Provider authentication state. Unknown means the agent advertises auth methods but exposes no probe.

vocabularies.name: ModelSwitchSupport
vocabularies.description: Whether a provider can change the active model for a thread.

vocabularies.name: TerminalStatus
vocabularies.description: Lifecycle of a terminal thread's shell run. Unknown future values must render as a neutral unavailable state.

vocabularies.name: TerminalStreamItemKind
vocabularies.description: Payload discriminator of a terminal.subscribe notification.

vocabularies.name: TerminalListStreamItemKind
vocabularies.description: Payload discriminator of a terminal.subscribeList snapshot or update.

vocabularies.name: TerminalAgentActivity
vocabularies.description: Semantic activity of a terminal's detected coding agent. Blocked renders as “Needs input”; unknown renders neutrally, never as an error.
